name: The Alchemist
source:
Play the role of an apprentice alchemist on the road in a merchant caravan. During the journey you will discover many things, including love?

[From [url=https://azephir.itch.io/the-alchemist]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
扮演一位隨商隊旅行的鍊金術學徒。在旅途中，你將發現許多事物，也許包括愛情？

［摘自[url=https://azephir.itch.io/the-alchemist]itch.io[/url]］
